provenance.method: Hand-authored offline evidence pack modeling the documented OpenCode 1.17.18 CLI, NDJSON transport, and debug/export JSON contract. No live OpenCode process, network access, or real provider/model was used; every fixture is a static, version-pinned test double checked into the repository.

fixtures.description: Clean single-session architect run producing one terminal text with a handoff, ISSUE_REF_JSON, and AGENT_STATUS: READY.
Clean architect run that reports AGENT_STATUS: FAILED with a non-empty explanation before any handoff is produced.
Clean coder run with one tool call followed by a single terminal text ending in AGENT_STATUS: COMPLETED.
Clean coder run that reports AGENT_STATUS: FAILED with a non-empty explanation after a failed tool call.
Clean reviewer run whose sole terminal text line is REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED with an empty body.
Clean reviewer run reporting REVIEW_STATUS: CHANGES_REQUIRED with a non-empty body; a valid parse with outcome SUCCEEDED.
Clean reviewer run that reports AGENT_STATUS: FAILED with a non-empty explanation when review cannot proceed.

Stream ends after an uncompleted tool call with no session.error event and no terminal text; paired with a non-zero exit code (1) and no trusted provider signal, so it must not authorize a provider retry.
Stream stops mid-reasoning with no terminal text at all, modeling a killed child whose return code is nullable rather than observed.
Trusted session.error event carrying HTTP 429 / rate_limit_exceeded, the canonical transient provider signature.
Trusted session.error event carrying HTTP 502 / bad_gateway, the canonical transient provider signature.
Trusted session.error event carrying the provider_unavailable code, the canonical transient provider signature.
Trusted session.error event carrying the overloaded_error code, the canonical transient provider signature.
Trusted session.error event carrying a textual rate_limit code distinct from the numeric 429 signature.
Trust-boundary case: the terminal assistant text mentions 429 and rate limit as ordinary prose with no session.error event; must not be classified as a trusted provider signal.
Trust-boundary case: a tool call's captured output mentions 502 Bad Gateway with no session.error event; must not be classified as a trusted provider signal.
Second line is not valid JSON at all, modeling a truncated or corrupted NDJSON stream.
Well-formed JSON line whose event type is outside the 1.17.18 schema allowlist.
Two lines carry different sessionID values, modeling an ambiguous or interleaved transport.
Stream ends with only a reasoning part and a still-running tool call; no completed terminal text part ever appears.
Two distinct messageID groups both present a completed terminal text candidate, making the terminal message ambiguous.
A tool call's captured output contains a literal AGENT_STATUS: READY line; only the true terminal text part may feed the protocol parser.
A reasoning part mentions AGENT_STATUS: COMPLETED as prose; reasoning parts must never feed the protocol parser.
Raw captured stdout bytes that are not valid UTF-8, modeling a strict-decode failure before any NDJSON parsing is attempted.
Raw captured stdout mixing a plain-text CLI fallback warning line ahead of otherwise valid NDJSON, modeling the silent default-agent fallback that must fail the transport.
opencode debug config output with manual sharing and auto-update disabled, the accepted preflight baseline.
opencode debug config output with share set to auto and autoshare true; preflight must reject automatic sharing.
opencode debug agent architect output: primary mode, no ask/task tools, read-only permission matrix.
opencode debug agent coder output: primary mode, no ask/task tools, edit/bash permission allowed for the target.
opencode debug agent reviewer output: primary mode, no ask/task tools, read-only permission matrix.
opencode debug agent architect output with the ask tool enabled; preflight must reject it.
opencode debug agent coder output with the task tool enabled; preflight must reject any subagent delegation capability.
opencode debug agent reviewer output reporting mode subagent instead of primary; preflight must reject non-primary agents.
opencode debug agent architect output granting edit permission; preflight must reject any effective policy more permissive than the reviewed read-only baseline.
opencode debug agent output for a role that is not defined in the OpenCode configuration at all.
Sanitized export whose single top-level assistant message reports info.agent architect, matching the requested role.
Sanitized export whose single top-level assistant message reports info.agent coder, matching the requested role.
Sanitized export whose single top-level assistant message reports info.agent reviewer, matching the requested role.
Sanitized export for a session started as architect whose assistant message reports info.agent coder, modeling a silent fallback identity mismatch.
Sanitized export whose assistant message info object has no agent field at all, modeling an unexpected export schema.
Sanitized export whose only message is from the user; no top-level assistant message exists to prove agent identity.
Sanitized export with two top-level assistant messages reporting different info.agent values, one of them the default fallback agent.
